notes.title: To steal or not to steal... Here's what we're thinking about this week
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey, Early Access players![/b][/h3][p]Welcome to another new week and thanks again for playing Eyes of Hellfire. It’s been great to see people stream the game and also share clips from their sessions. Speaking of, [url="https://youtube.com/shorts/aWjnfqUJsyY?si=ELdn6apAvuDrMRUv"]we loved this clip[/url] from Jesse Cox! [/p][p]If you have social clips to share with us, you can do so [url="https://discord.com/invite/gambrinous"]in our Discord[/url]![/p][p]This week we’re having a mull over many different things as usual, thanks to your brilliant feedback and reviews. [/p][p]While we can’t respond to everyone (we’re a small team after all!), we’re delighted to see them and we’re listening. Here’s what we’re thinking about right now.[/p][p]=======================[/p][h3][b]I choose you![/b][/h3][p]We’re always intrigued to see who prefers certain characters over others. For me (Úna-Minh), I’m always drawn to healers in games, so I tend to gravitate to Patrick. Though so is my colleague Gary ([url="https://youtu.be/rUG2geU7mmM?si=YAspGhfjRp4G4G5D"]Eyes of Hellfire Composer[/url]) and whenever we’re playtesting, we fight over who gets him first! [/p][p]For others, they tend to prefer Fionn for their abilities when alone in sections, which can make them super powerful in fights towards the endgame.[/p][p]Who do you play as? Let us know!  And also, [b]if there are types of characters you’d love to see, we’d be curious to hear your ideas too.[/b][/p][p]=======================[/p][h3][b]To steal or not to steal[/b][/h3][p]Speaking of character choices, we’d also love to find out if YOU are the stealer of your group. Everyone’s playstyle is different and for some folks on the Gambrinous team, they are serial stealers, [i]cough[/i] Colm [i]cough.[/i] [/p][p]Or perhaps you like to do things more stealthily and like to take that particular offer from the Host… hmmm. We’re keeping an eye on you…[/p][p]Or maybe you don't like to steal at all! Though, having a lot of seals to trade in at The Host's Table is quite nice... right?[/p][p]=======================[/p][h3][b]Psst![/b][/h3][p]By the way, did you see the really fun playthrough vid by ManlyBadasshero over on YouTube? You should go watch it![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/-5mEqozFZns?si=e9Ib4xlBT0Q-uxbh"][/dynamiclink]=======================[/p][h3][b]Some nice reviews on our radar this week:[/b][/h3][p]"Combining board-game elements with a creepy atmosphere, this game went beyond my expectations. More than worth the time of you and your buddies"[/p][p]"Thumbs up for the friends pass alone"[/p][p]"G A M E G O O D" (Need we say more?!)[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again and connect with us on Discord (or [i]do what thou wilt[/i])[/p][p]~ Úna-Minh[/p]

notes.title: Eyes of Hellfire Update: Here's what we're thinking about this week
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey, Early Access players![/b][/h3][p]We’re kickstarting a new week here at Gambrinous after celebrating our Launch Party last Friday. It was a super night all around and really wonderful to celebrate the milestone of reaching Early Access (We even had themed cocktails!). [/p][p]This week we’re back at it, and having a mull over a few things as usual, thanks to your feedback. Keep it coming.[/p][p]==================================[/p][h3][b]Signalling![/b][/h3][p]While we’re proponents of discovering things and puzzles on your own, there are definitely elements of actual gameplay that deserve stronger signalling to help the player understand why / how things are happening. Be it an explanation as to why you’ve suddenly appeared in another room after getting hit by an enemy, or trying to explain that an item is more powerful/rewarding than the one you have in hand. We’re on it.[/p][p]==================================[/p][h3][b]Settings[/b][/h3][p]Currently, we have basic settings in place, which we prioritised for the Early Access launch, but we intend to expand on them. We are also planning accessibility consultations as we continue to build our game. While we don’t have the scope to implement everything, it’s still something we’re conscious of.[/p][p]==================================[/p][h3][b]Some nice reviews this week:[/b][/h3][p]“As an avid tabletop gamer who has played many of the games that inspired this one, I can see the vision. I honestly adore the vision. It is attempting to do something very unique, and I am excited to see where it goes.”[/p][p]“Absolutely love this game. They nailed the board game style, mirroring the style of Mansions of Madness and Betrayal at House on the Hill. It's intense, action-packed at times, and has a cool way to allow your team to figure out next steps. The atmosphere is creepy and sets the mood. Few good scares in it too. Looking forward to playing more as they add scenarios!”[/p][p]“ːsteamthumbsupː” (Short and concise - what more could you want?)[/p][p]Want to connect with us or have some ideas? Join us in our [url="https://discord.com/invite/gambrinous"]Gambrinous Discord[/url] or [i]do what thou wilt.[/i][/p][p]Thanks again![/p][p]~ Úna-Minh[/p]

notes.title: Build 0.1.2025.9.11 patch notes
notes.content:
Build 0.1.2025.9.11 patch notes

[list]
[*] Fixes for a number of soft locks in the host table. The Host really didn't want you taking his cards!
[*] Fixed a duplicate wine bottle in the wine rack puzzle screen. There was a 1 in 20 chance the puzzle was unsolvable
[*] Removed a leftover wine bottle quest item that had no use in the game. Sorry AndradaCat from Discord!
[*] Fixed objectives not advancing after placing the paints
[*] A couple of fixes for stuck Monsters/Players during fights
[*] Fixed Monsters not always exhausting after an Attack
[*] Fixed Masterpiece texture stretching
[*] Fixed Shrouds/Living Paintings not patrolling
[*] Rebalanced XP gains and requirements. Level 2 will be a breeze!
[*] Fixed objectives not cleaning up after previous session
[*] Fixed not being able to return to main menu after the ruins transition
[*] Fixed not being recognised as having taken an offer after the revenge offer
[*] Prevent dropping items/cards in the tutorial, as it can break the scripted tutorial flow
[*] Typos and wording edits
[*] Temporarily disabled music during Masterpiece fight
[/list]

Known Issues:
[olist]
[*] Sometimes you can get a "lobby not found" message when attempting to join a lobby with a code. A workaround for now is to join the game from a steam invite while you are in the create/join screen.
[*] XP gain in the end game summary screen does not always reflect the actual XP gained in some cases
[*] Sometimes you can get stuck moving between sections if using keyboard. Clicking in the destination section should get you unstuck. We are continuing to investigate
[/olist]

notes.title: Localisation, Boss Fights and Curses: Here's what we're thinking about
notes.content: [h1][b]Hey Early Access players![/b][/h1][p]Thanks so much for all the love on our previous posts, where [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1724030/view/514093693489120477?l=english"]we reintroduced ourselves[/url] and for all the feedback you’ve been giving us so far. [/p][p]Here are some things that you’ve been talking about:[/p][h3][b]Localisation! [/b][/h3][p]These are planned for Early Access and [b]we’re already spec'ing this out behind the scenes[/b]. As you can imagine, there are some systems we need to get rocking on before the translation becomes available - and testing too - so it’s not just a simple task![/p][p]We’re excited though to hear what you think when the time comes. [b]Let us know what languages you’d love to see.[/b][/p][p]==============================================[/p][h3][b]The Eyes of Hellfire ‘curse’[/b] [/h3][p]We’re thinking about this one for sure. All of our curses in-game are quite distinctive, and this one is a bit trickier to portray. But in a nutshell, whoever has the ‘Eyes’ must keep extra vigilant throughout the game and see what other players are up to. There are bluffing elements too, and this is where our proximity chat shines where players can try to get others to reveal what curses they are doing accidentally. [/p][p]Has a player made a comment about completing their curse? [/p][p]What were they doing? [/p][p]Have you noticed them stealing a bit TOO much? [/p][p]Or getting wounded far too often? [/p][p][i]Hmmm suspicious…[/i] [/p][p]We’re really thinking more about how we present curses and there are lots of ideas swirling around![/p][p]==============================================[/p][h3][b]Save States[/b][/h3][p]Yes! We want them, you want them. Rest assured, they're on the way. Take a look at our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1724030/view/514093058994733469?l=english"]roadmap here[/url].[/p][p]==============================================[/p][h3][b]The Big Boss[/b][/h3][p]We’ve been having some mixed feelings about the main boss fight. Sometimes it’s too easy, sometimes it’s very satisfying (with the right build) and sometimes it’s just annoying and too hard. But we need fresh eyes - We want to improve it and to do that we want to hear from you. What do you like about it? What don’t you like about it? Let us know. We’re all ears. [/p][p]Note: For feedback like this, it’s best via our Discord.[/p][p]==============================================[/p][h3][b]Skippable Cutscenes[/b][/h3][p]In case you didn't know, these are already in (apart from the short one at the Host's Table)! For those who want to: You can skip cutscenes, just click ‘esc’ during them for a group skip.[/p][p]==============================================[/p][p][b]And now, here are some other nice things reviewers have been saying about Eyes of Hellfire:[/b][/p][p]“A fascinating blend of genres. Turn-based, Survival Horror, Deckbuilder, Social Deduction. Somehow, none of these elements feel like they clash with each other. “[/p][p]“I'm super excited to see how Eyes of Hellfire polishes into the incredible game I think it is poised to be, especially for lovers of Betrayal at the House on the Hill (who love their friends but hate all that pesky board game setup)”[/p][p]“As soon as I saw 'perfect for fans of cooperative horror games like Arkham Horror, Betrayal at House on the Hill, (especially) and Mansions of Madness AND Based on real Irish legends (!?) I was immediately enthralled.”[/p][p]==============================================[/p][p]Want to connect with us or have some ideas? Join us in our [url="https://discord.com/invite/gambrinous"]Gambrinous Discord here[/url] or [i]do what thou wilt.[/i][/p][p]Thanks again! And let's keep cooking.[/p][p]~ Úna-Minh[/p]

notes.title: Thank you Early Access Players!
notes.content: [h1]Hello Early Access players![/h1][p]Thank you so much for playing, reviewing and in general checking out our first co-op gothic horror game [i]Eyes of Hellfire[/i]. We’d love to reintroduce ourselves![/p][p]We - the developers - are [b]Gambrinous, an indie Irish team of 10 folks based in Ireland[/b] too. [i]Eyes of Hellfire[/i] is inspired by the real Irish folklore of the Hellfire Club in the Dublin mountains and in fact we hiked up to the Hellfire Club recently (see below!) [/p][p]We’re thrilled that [b]Blumhouse Games has published our game[/b] and loved seeing/reading your reactions across all socials, here on Steam and on stream. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516321/5384389f199933d2495fcb964d5de47dc21a3871.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516321/fd7c7deeba2322ef02625b425e251b004b231db8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Here’s a flavour of what you seem to like the most:[/b][/h3][p]“It feels like exactly what I wanted it to be: a tabletop experience I can play with my friends online.”[/p][p]“Art direction is very strong, with atmosphere in the environments and loads of personality in the characters”.[/p][p]“The atmosphere is creepy, the art is lovely, and the fact that I can buy it and my friends don't have to right away is the icing on a very spooky cake.”[/p][p]Rest assured, [b]we do have Save States on the way[/b] as we appreciate that it takes time to play through Scenario 1![/p][p]Things you don't like? Bugs. We don’t like them either! But we really do appreciate your patience. [/p][p]We’ve also gotten a lot of great feedback from the community, as well as bug reports that we're working on.[/p][p]This is exactly what our Early Access period is about, working with the community, and we’re thrilled to have such an attentive one already who are helping us squash those bugs. Just please note that because [b]we’re a small indie team in Ireland, our time zone / work week may differ from yours[/b].[/p][p]You can find us mostly chatting away [url="https://discord.com/invite/gambrinous"]on our Discord[/url] where we also have a space for feedback, bug reports and folks looking for games’. [/p][p]Speaking of, folks had questions about match-matching and single-player mode. We shared our thoughts along with answers [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1724030/discussions/0/604165686037765039/"]to other qs here[/url]. But in a nutshell:[/p][p][i]Eyes of Hellfire[/i] is not suited for single-player mode. There are puzzles, curses, combat elements and other features within the game that would not be possible for a single player to complete.[/p][p]We have no current plans to allow for random matchmaking with strangers. We feel players will be less likely to have a great time with that setup. As mentioned, the game needs a bigger time commitment for things to be fun, which we don't think is compatible with random matchmaking.[/p][p]Instead, we encourage coordinating with friends to start a game / find players to group with via other places, for example, our ⁠"looking for group" channel on our Discord server.[/p][p]But we will say we're watching carefully and not entirely ruling out something like this in future![/p][h3][b]Check out [/b][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1724030/view/514093058994733469?l=english"]our Road Map[/url][/b][b] - we've got a lot of exciting things coming up soon![/b][/h3][p]We’re just getting started and there's new and exciting things waiting in the wings. We’re stoked to keep working on our gothic horror title![/p][p]Thank you all again for being part of our Early Access period. [/p][h3][b]~ The Gambrinous Team[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Welcome to the Club! Eyes of Hellfire is OUT NOW
notes.content: [h1]The doors to the Lodge have opened, welcome to the Club![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516321/a66e5b6f9cec162cde62d1638d814aaec89e9440.png"][/img][/p][p]After more than two years of development we're incredibly excited to be launching Eyes of Hellfire into Early Access today. This game has already been influenced by community feedback from our prior two playtests, and that collaboration will continue in this Early Access journey. Today we're launching with a ton of features and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1724030/view/514093058994733469?l=english"]more to come[/url].[/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]Colm, and the rest of the Gambrinous team.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724030/Eyes_of_Hellfire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Friends play free with Friends Pass:[/h3][list][*][p]If you pick up a copy of the game up to 4 of your friends can join you for free by installing the friends pass. Quite a deal![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Some quotes from playtesters:[/h3][list][*][p]“Hearing my friend scream from down the hall was a delight.”[/p][/*][*][p]"You have made Irish history of the Hellfire club relevant again!"[/p][/*][*][p]“And now a round of applause for the proximity chat, better than most game I've played. It doesn't feel cheap, like a linear volume graph based on distance, we really felt in the game with this one. Hearing each other scream with a reverb was GOLD COMEDY. Congrats!”[/p][/*][*][p]“It feels very unique. And I am a person who regularly watches streamers play horror games, so I would eat this up, especially if it has some overarching plot I haven't seen”[/p][/*][*][p]“The artstyle is amazing, the game's atmosphere is on point.”[/p][/*][*][p]“Just the fact it isn't your typical scary game, I still had a couple jump scares, but it's a new take on card games, it's like card meets horror. I also enjoy that type of card games, the health and vigour aspect”.[/p][/*][*][p]“I enjoy the artstyle, figuring out riddles together is great. I also love that the game allows this many players, usually games max out at 4”.[/p][/*][*][p]“I really liked when I got personally "spoken" to, telling me to not tell my friends about it. It made it feel more exciting and inclusive”.[/p][/*][*][p]“The atmosphere and staging itself was amazing. I liked the old school paranormal vibes along with the architecture of the game. The dark ambience definitely fit the gothic vibes that they were going for. The cutscenes were well done and I like the way the quest items fit into the storyline as well. Nothing felt out of place”.[/p][/*][*][p]“I love a good backstory and lore to each character and a game in general. This game seemed to have all of that, it was really fun to read through each character's bio and get a deeper understanding from the journal”.[/p][/*][*][p]“You guys nailed it with the atmosphere!! Right at the start of the game I got shivers. Everything is in the right place, the sounds, the music theme, the art style. Definitely a gothic game clearly characterized by mystery. The writing is in the right direction and the playable characters theme GREAT!”[/p][/*][*][p]“You can tell there's a lot of heart and soul put into the game”[/p][/*][*][p]“It was a game I have never seen, it's been a while since we got a unique and very good horror game and THIS IS IT.”[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]What you and your friends will be able to play today:[/h3][list][*][p]Five Playable Characters with 3D models, animations, unique cards, backstories and voice lines[/p][/*][*][p]Corruption System[/p][/*][*][p]Proximity Chat[/p][/*][*][p]Combat System[/p][/*][*][p]In-game cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Suite of player cards: 20 skill cards (10 at start, 10 to unlock), and 45 item cards to find[/p][/*][*][p]Three types of Seals[/p][/*][*][p]5 Relics to discover[/p][/*][*][p]Player Emotes[/p][/*][*][p]9 Player Curses[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters, miniboss and boss[/p][/*][*][p]Full voice acting for The Host and our five main playable characters[/p][/*][*][p]Complete Scenario One[/p][/*][*][p]Many Puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]Full sound design[/p][/*][*][p]Meta Progression including:[/p][olist][*][p]Two different emotes (Indicating ‘pointing’ and ‘shock’)[/p][/*][*][p]An alternate starting deck (unlockable for each character)[/p][/*][*][p]A special card (unique to each character)[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="AiGvdTFhWoE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]While we'll of course be looking at the Steam forums for your thoughts, we want to invite you to join our [url="https://discord.gg/gambrinous"]Discord[/url] for a more direct interaction with the development team.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1724030/view/514093058994733469?l=english" style="button"]Early Access Roadmap[/url][/p]
